fact: The preprint says the Ghana Meteorological Agency's existing dish receives EUMETSAT MSG data for NWCSAF processing with 15-minute latency, and that Ghana was first of the African SWIFT partners to operationalise NWCSAF for in-country nowcasting.

The authors say that after NWCSAF and impact-based forecasting were introduced GMet intensified dissemination of regular nowcasts and impact-based forecasts to major stakeholders for early warning, while integrating KNUST and GMet NWCSAF resources was still underway.

TechReviewAfrica reports the Ghana Meteorological Agency received the PUMA-2025 and ClimSA stations under the EU-funded ClimSA project, giving access to Meteosat Third Generation data with images every 10 minutes, and that its staff were trained in forecasting and system administration.
